summary.en: Answer @question with the Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Kiro subscription you already have, from one AI picker in Settings → AI. Settings → Input can make Caps Lock switch Chinese and English instead of Shift (Shift stays the default). Lighter settings: less-used options folded away.
summary.zh: @question 可以用你已有的 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 或 Kiro 订阅回答，设置 →「AI」里一个选择器管所有 AI。设置 →「输入」里可以改用大写锁定键切换中英文（默认仍是 Shift）。设置更清爽：不常用的选项收起来了。
